# pixel

> Frontend taste you can put in CI: an agent employee that scaffolds Next.js 16 apps and blocks UI that looks AI-made.

pixel is the Energy fleet's frontend web designer-engineer: a highly opinionated harness that scaffolds,
designs-to-taste, generates-then-gates, and verifies Next.js 16 / Tailwind v4 / shadcn UI. It treats every generated
UI as an untrusted draft and ships only what survives the taste gates. The moat is the audit/taste gate
(`impeccable detect` + the design-systems 12-dimension audit), not the generator. Its surfaces are the CLI, the
`pixel-mcp` MCP server, the skills, two sub-agents, a Claude Code plugin, a Gemini CLI extension and the local cockpit.
Read `brain/` first.

## Agent docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what pixel does, the full `pixel <cmd>` tool list, the MCP tools, the REFUSES boundary, "read brain/ first".
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): pixel's operating doc — stack pins, the 8-job loop, the §0 grep-set discipline, the untrusted-draft rule, commit convention.
- [brain/MOC - pixel.md](brain/MOC%20-%20pixel.md): the brain hub — wikilinks to every expertise note.
- [GEMINI.md](GEMINI.md): Gemini CLI's context file; it imports AGENTS.md.
- [README.md](README.md): what pixel is, the one-step install for every coding agent, the quick start.

## CLI (the hands — `pixel <cmd>`)

- `pixel mock "<brief>" [--out DIR] [--no-sandbox] [--json]`: THE FLAGSHIP — discovery brief → first-pass draft → 7-step gate → ICP-aware mockup + scaffolded Next app. Exit non-0 if the gate fails.
- `pixel scaffold [DIR] [--base radix]`: clean Next 16 app via `shadcn init -t next --base radix`; wires Tailwind v4 @theme + house tokens.
- `pixel design "<brief>" [--vertical …]`: discovery brief + FIRST/SECOND/THIRD hierarchy map. NO BRIEF = NO DESIGN.
- `pixel generate "<prompt>" [--model …] [--out DIR]`: v0 Platform API draft (untrusted — must pass `pixel audit`).
- `pixel audit [DIR] [--sandbox] [--fix]`: the 7-step ship gate — impeccable → axe → lhci → 12-dim → manual-a11y → security → visual. Exit-code gate.
- `pixel verify [DIR]`: the silent-failure assertion set — §0 grep-set + build + screenshot + console=0-hydration.
- `pixel migrate [DIR] [--from 15]`: codemod-then-grep upgrade, then `pixel verify` for the gap.
- `pixel cockpit [--port 7780]`: serve the localhost cockpit (brain browser · run log · eval scores · ask-the-employee · mockup gallery).
- `pixel logs [--last N]`: aggregate `logs/runs.jsonl` (cost/latency/gate-results per run).

## MCP server (`pixel-mcp` — JSON-RPC over stdio)

- [src/mcp-server.ts](src/mcp-server.ts): the server. Start it with `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/pixel pixel-mcp`; [.mcp.json](.mcp.json) does that for you, and [.mcp.dev.json](.mcp.dev.json) starts the local build.

- `pixel_mock(brief, out?)`: the flagship over MCP → `{mockup_path, app_path, gate_report}`.
- `pixel_scaffold(dir, base?)`: clean Next 16 app.
- `pixel_design(brief, vertical?)`: discovery brief + hierarchy map.
- `pixel_generate(prompt, model?)`: v0 draft (untrusted).
- `pixel_audit(dir, sandbox?)`: the 7-step gate.
- `pixel_verify(dir)`: silent-failure check.
- `pixel_taste_check(code)`: impeccable + opinions over a snippet (the cheapest call).
- `pixel_brain_search(query)`: BM25 over `brain/` (the Memory layer over MCP).

## Skills (repo-authored — each encodes a named OPINIONS/PITFALLS stance)

- [skills/pixel-anti-slop/SKILL.md](skills/pixel-anti-slop/SKILL.md): the deterministic "does my own output look AI-made" check — O-HS1..7 + O-F1 (indigo override) + the impeccable 41-rule gate.
- [skills/pixel-rsc-boundary/SKILL.md](skills/pixel-rsc-boundary/SKILL.md): the RSC serialization boundary — PITFALLS §5 + the 5 boundary mistakes + S8/S20.
- [skills/pixel-animate/SKILL.md](skills/pixel-animate/SKILL.md): the lowest-layer animation ladder + the Lenis+GSAP one-rAF recipe (`autoRaf:false`, S5) + `LazyMotion`+`m` (O5).
- [skills/pixel-migrate-next16/SKILL.md](skills/pixel-migrate-next16/SKILL.md): the §0 grep-set + S1 (`middleware.ts`→`proxy.ts`) + S17 + S18 + codemod-then-grep (O13).
- [skills/pixel-ship-gate/SKILL.md](skills/pixel-ship-gate/SKILL.md): the 7-step ship gate + WCAG 2.2 AA + CWV 2026 (LCP 2.0s/INP 200ms/CLS 0.1) + S15/S16.
- [skills/pixel-agent-ui/SKILL.md](skills/pixel-agent-ui/SKILL.md): designing screens where people work with AI agents (rosters, chats, watch-it-work panels, memory views).
- [skills/pixel-brain-page/SKILL.md](skills/pixel-brain-page/SKILL.md): the reading-page look for long documents (one sans family, light paper, contents on the left, depth one click away).
- [skills/](skills/): 24 more vendored design skills (shadcn, Tailwind, accessibility, Figma-to-code and others), each crediting its source.

- [.claude/agents/pixel-migration-pilot.md](.claude/agents/pixel-migration-pilot.md): codemod-then-grep Next/Tailwind upgrade pilot — owns the migration silent-failure class.

## Acceptance test (the bar)

`pixel mock "<brief>"` → ICP-aware mockup + scaffolded Next 16 app, then `npx impeccable detect --json <out>/app/src` exits 0 (keyless) AND a Playwright smoke passes. Run by the red-blocking `acceptance` job in [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml); it is GT1 in `eval/eval.mjs`.
